group.presentation-library.entry.intro.c: Each dialogue lets you inspect the new effects, masks, cards, weather and audio.
group.presentation-library.entry.cards.c: Nine independent anchors. Right-side cards enter from the right.
group.presentation-library.entry.mask-Le: LetterboxIn uses an independent feathered mask.
LetterboxOut uses an independent feathered mask.
group.presentation-library.entry.mask-Bl: Blink uses an independent feathered mask.
group.presentation-library.entry.mask-Op: Open uses an independent feathered mask.

The second mask covered dialogue and text cards too.
group.presentation-library.entry.idle-Br: Breathe returns to the original pose when stopped.
group.presentation-library.entry.idle-Sw: Sway returns to the original pose when stopped.
group.presentation-library.entry.mood-Me: Memory can enter and exit independently.
group.presentation-library.entry.mood-Dr: Dream can enter and exit independently.
group.presentation-library.entry.mood-Te: Tension can enter and exit independently.
group.presentation-library.entry.mood-In: Injury can enter and exit independently.
group.presentation-library.entry.heartbe: A repeating double heartbeat drives vignette and relative zoom.
group.presentation-library.entry.paralla: Each layer supplies an explicit baseline and motion factor.
